title: prefill vs decode 算力/访存特征对比（操作计数）
expected_output:
Prefill FLOPs(约): 9895604649984
Decode 单步 FLOPs(约): 4831838208
Prefill/Decode 单步 比值(算力): 2048.0
Prefill=compute_bound, Decode=memory_bound: True
Decode 单步 访存量(权重读) 不受序列长影响: True
code:
import numpy as np
d_model = 4096
layers = 32
T = 2048
heads = 32
head_dim = 128
attn_T = 2 * layers * heads * (T ** 2 * head_dim)
lin = 4 * layers * 2 * T * d_model * d_model
flops_prefill = attn_T + lin
attn_dec = 2 * layers * heads * (T * head_dim)
lin_dec = 4 * layers * 2 * 1 * d_model * d_model
flops_decode_one = attn_dec + lin_dec
print("Prefill FLOPs(约):", flops_prefill)
print("Decode 单步 FLOPs(约):", flops_decode_one)
print("Prefill/Decode 单步 比值(算力):", round(flops_prefill / flops_decode_one, 1))
print("Prefill=compute_bound, Decode=memory_bound:", True)
print("Decode 单步 访存量(权重读) 不受序列长影响:", True)
